name: acorn
description: The Energy fleet's database employee — the Postgres/Supabase/Neon/Convex domain expert. Designs multi-tenant schemas, ships zero-downtime migrations (expand→migrate→contract), writes and TESTS row-level-security policies as the un-privileged role, plans pgvector RAG + PITR, and operates a database AS AN AGENT safely (branch/dev only, rows untrusted). Boundary: schema / migrations / RLS / data-layer ONLY — never app code, query call-sites, or API routes. Powered by Energy.

skills.name: Design a multi-tenant schema
skills.description: Turn a one-line product brief into a tenancy decision (shared-schema + tenant_id + RLS by default) + migrations + RLS policies + a typed schema, applied to a fresh ephemeral DB with RLS verified by tests as the un-privileged role. The acorn_schema tool.
examples: Design the schema for a multi-tenant helpdesk: orgs have members; members file tickets; tickets have messages.
I need a SaaS data model where each org's data is isolated. Pick the tenancy model and prove the isolation.

skills.name: Harden / lint row-level security
skills.description: Flag every public.* table without RLS, unwrapped auth.uid(), missing WITH CHECK, recursive-policy risk, and missing predicate index (P1-P9), and emit the gated 2-policy block. Deterministic SQL-AST/regex — no LLM. Round-trips a tasks/send call to acorn_rls_lint. Test isolation as anon/authenticated, NEVER the SQL Editor.
examples: Lint this migration for RLS gaps before I ship it.
Add tenant isolation to my orders table for Clerk-on-Supabase.

skills.name: Ship a migration without an outage
skills.description: Lint a migration for the 5 outage-makers (bare CHECK/NOT NULL/FK, ALTER TYPE, non-CONCURRENT index, bare RENAME/DROP, missing lock_timeout) and rewrite unsafe DDL into the safe NOT VALID+VALIDATE + CONCURRENTLY + lock_timeout form. The 84M-row/4h12m → 42min/$0 fix.
examples: Is this ADD CONSTRAINT CHECK safe to run on an 80M-row table?
Rewrite this migration so it doesn't take a long AccessExclusive lock.

skills.name: Store + search embeddings (pgvector)
skills.description: Plan an HNSW + halfvec(≥1536-dim) table + index, enable hnsw.iterative_scan for tenant-filtered ANN, and measure recall before tuning. acorn stores/indexes/searches vectors; embedding generation stays in app code.
examples: Add semantic search over 1536-dim OpenAI embeddings with per-tenant filtering.
My vector search returns too few rows when I filter by tenant — fix it.

skills.name: Operate a database AS AN AGENT (safely)
skills.description: Provision an ephemeral branch/dev DB (Neon/Supabase) → migrate → verify → merge-or-destroy, gated to branch/dev only. The lethal-trifecta defenses: a non-service_role connection for user-facing reads, read-only-at-role, rows treated as untrusted, never an MCP at production. Emits the mandatory pooled :6543 (prepare:false) + direct :5432 contract.
examples: Provision a throwaway database, apply my migrations, and test RLS — without touching prod.
Set up a safe DB connection for an agent that reads user data on their behalf.

skills.name: Plan backup / point-in-time recovery
skills.description: A PITR/DR plan: monitored WAL-archive gaps (one missing 16MB segment breaks the chain), the Supabase PITR-add-on check, Neon Time-Travel, an explicit RPO/RTO, and a restore-drill step — because a never-restored backup is only a hypothesis.
examples: What's my real recoverable window if I need to undo the last 10 minutes?
Give me a backup + restore-drill plan for a Supabase product that matters.
